pages.quiz:
GERMAN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which German word or phrase means "window"? (1 mark)
   A. das Fenster
   B. der Herd
   C. die Uhr
   D. das Haus

2. Which word has the sound "oy"? (1 mark)
   A. heute
   B. nein
   C. Haus
   D. Tier

3. What number is "sechs"? (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 14
   C. 18
   D. 2

4. What does "Zum Frühstück esse ich Brot" mean? (1 mark)
   A. For breakfast I eat bread
   B. For lunch I eat bread
   C. I bake bread
   D. I sell bread

5. What does "neblig" mean? (1 mark)
   A. sunny
   B. cloudy
   C. foggy
   D. rainy

6. Which day has a double t in the middle? (1 mark)
   A. Montag
   B. Freitag
   C. Mittwoch
   D. Samstag

7. Which German word or phrase means "juice"? (1 mark)
   A. der Kohl
   B. das Mittagessen
   C. der Saft
   D. der Reis

8. Which little word goes with the noun "Mutter"? (1 mark)
   A. das
   B. den
   C. die
   D. der

9. Which German word is the number 6? (1 mark)
   A. drei
   B. fünf
   C. sechs
   D. null

10. What should your voice do at a full stop? (1 mark)
   A. Whisper
   B. Go down and stop
   C. Speed up
   D. Go up

11. What does "die Wand" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. fridge
   B. wall
   C. lamp
   D. sofa

12. After "möchte", which form of the verb do we use? (1 mark)
   A. the -t form
   B. the -st form
   C. the -en form at the end
   D. the -e form

13. What does articulating a word mean? (1 mark)
   A. Saying each sound clearly
   B. Whispering it
   C. Writing it neatly
   D. Saying it as fast as possible

14. What does "der vierte" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. fourth
   B. sixth
   C. fifth
   D. third

15. What is the plural of "der Apfel"? (1 mark)
   A. die Apfeler
   B. die Apfels
   C. die Äpfel
   D. die Apfele

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Write the German words with der, die or das for: present, aunt, mango. (3 marks)

17. Write the German words with der, die or das for: sugar, child, sofa. (3 marks)

18. Write the German words with der, die or das for: balloon, arm, sister, shoulder. (4 marks)

19. Write the German words with der, die or das for: cabbage or kale, toilet, fog. (3 marks)

20. Write in German: "Who is that? That is my mother." (2 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — das Fenster
   window in German is das Fenster.

2. A — heute
   The letters eu sound like oy, so heute is HOY-te.

3. A — 6
   sechs is the number 6.

4. A — For breakfast I eat bread
   Frühstück is breakfast.

5. C — foggy
   Nebel is fog and neblig means foggy.

6. C — Mittwoch
   Mittwoch is spelled with tt.

7. C — der Saft
   juice in German is der Saft.

8. C — die
   It is die Mutter, so the little word is die.

9. C — sechs
   6 in German is sechs.

10. B — Go down and stop
   A full stop (der Punkt) tells us to end the sentence with a falling voice.

11. B — wall
   die Wand means wall.

12. C — the -en form at the end
   Ich möchte tanzen: the second verb is in the basic -en form and goes to the end.

13. A — Saying each sound clearly
   Articulation is moving lips, tongue and teeth to say each sound clearly.

14. A — fourth
   der vierte means fourth.

15. C — die Äpfel
   The plural of der Apfel is die Äpfel.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: das Geschenk, die Tante, die Mango.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: der Zucker, das Kind, das Sofa.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

18. (4 marks)
   Answer: der Luftballon, der Arm, die Schwester, die Schulter.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: der Kohl, die Toilette, der Nebel.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: Wer ist das? Das ist meine Mutter.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sentence.
